title: briza poiformis
intro: Briza poiformis, commonly known as quaking grass, is a type of flowering plant native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and soothing digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Briza poiformis include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help in alleviating conditions such as bronchitis, asthma, and coughs. The bioactive constituents present in Briza poiformis include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
